teacher_info.intro:
¡Hola! I'm Belén, a Spanish and English teacher from Chile. I hold a Bachelor's degree in Language teaching. I've spent 5 years of in-person school teaching and teaching Spanish online since 2018. Raised in the southernmost zone of Chile, Patagonia. I love latin dancing, traveling and real connections with people.

I love what I do because it gives me the incredible opportunity not only to teach my native language but also to meet amazing people from different corners of the world. Through these connections, I learn from them and their cultures. I enjoy listening to what they have to say about their lives and interesting things happening where they live. 

Let's start learning together!

As a passionate Spanish teacher, I enjoy connecting with students from all over the world. My teaching philosophy centers on creating an engaging and supportive learning environment where students feel comfortable and confident in their language journey.

I believe in the power of active listening and always strive to understand my students' individual needs and goals. This personalized approach allows me to tailor my lessons to each student's learning style, ensuring that they are both enjoyable and effective.
teacher_info.teaching_style: I offer Spanish classes tailored to different proficiency levels: Beginner (from scratch), Intermediate, and Advanced, and adapted to your own pace. In my classes, you can expect conversational practice, and/or a blend of structured grammar and vocabulary instruction, and cultural exploration. Whether you're a beginner or looking to refine your skills, I'm here to guide you every step of the way, helping you to achieve fluency and confidence in Spanish.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for Beginners (A1) – Build a Strong Foundation
pro_course_detail.description:
Start your Spanish journey with a solid foundation! This beginner-friendly course is designed for absolute beginners and those with little experience in Spanish. You'll learn essential vocabulary, basic grammar structures, and useful expressions to communicate in everyday situations.

✅ Master common phrases for introductions, shopping, dining, and travel.
✅ Gain confidence in pronunciation and listening comprehension.
✅ Interactive exercises, role-playing, and real-life dialogues.
✅ Exclusive downloadable materials, flashcards, and quizzes to track your progress.

By the end of this course, you'll be able to introduce yourself, ask and answer basic questions, and navigate common situations with ease.

📌 Perfect for: Absolute beginners and travelers who want to start speaking Spanish fast!

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for Elementary Learners (A2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Take your Spanish to the next level! This course is perfect for learners who already know the basics and want to expand their vocabulary, improve their grammar, and hold simple conversations.

✅ Learn how to express past and future events.
✅ Speak more fluently about your daily life, hobbies, and plans.
✅ Improve your listening and pronunciation skills with engaging exercises.
✅ Get personalized feedback and practice real-world scenarios.

By the end of this course, you'll be able to handle everyday interactions, describe experiences, and express opinions with greater ease.

📌 Perfect for: Those who know basic Spanish and want to communicate more naturally.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for Intermediate Learners (B1)
pro_course_detail.description:
Are you ready to move beyond simple sentences and have real conversations? This course will help you develop more natural speech patterns and improve your comprehension skills.

✅ Master more complex grammar structures, such as subjunctive and past tenses.
✅ Express ideas, opinions, and emotions with greater confidence.
✅ Engage in meaningful conversations on topics like work, travel, and culture.
✅ Interactive lessons, storytelling, and real-world scenarios.

By the end of this course, you'll be able to participate in discussions, share your experiences, and understand Spanish in various contexts.

📌 Perfect for: Those who can already hold simple conversations and want to go deeper.

pro_course_detail.title: Explora el Inglés
pro_course_detail.description: En este curso, te sumergirás en el mundo del inglés de una manera práctica y dinámica. Te proporcionaré las herramientas esenciales para comunicarte con confianza en situaciones cotidianas.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for Upper-Intermediate Learners (B2)
pro_course_detail.description:
Achieve a higher level of fluency and express yourself with more nuance! This course is designed for learners who want to refine their speaking and comprehension skills.

✅ Speak about abstract topics, debates, and opinions with ease.
✅ Improve listening skills through real-life conversations and native speech.
✅ Learn advanced grammar structures to perfect your accuracy.
✅ Express yourself confidently in both formal and informal settings.

By the end of this course, you'll be able to hold conversations with native speakers, understand media content, and articulate thoughts clearly.

📌 Perfect for: Those who want to sound more natural and understand Spanish at a deeper level.

pro_course_detail.title: Spanish for Advanced Learners (C1) – Master the Language
pro_course_detail.description:
Take your Spanish to near-native fluency! This course is designed for students who already have a strong command of Spanish but want to polish their skills and communicate with full confidence.

✅ Discuss complex topics like culture, politics, and global issues.
✅ Develop a rich vocabulary and sound more like a native speaker.
✅ Perfect your grammar and eliminate common mistakes.
✅ Engage in deep conversations and express opinions effortlessly.

By the end of this course, you'll be able to communicate with full fluency in professional, academic, and social settings.

📌 Perfect for: Those who are comfortable in Spanish but want to reach full fluency.

pro_course_detail.title: Chat in Spanish (B1-C2) – Real Conversations, Real Fluency
pro_course_detail.description:
The best way to become fluent is by speaking! This conversation-based course is designed to help you develop confidence, improve pronunciation, and sound more natural in Spanish.

✅ Engage in spontaneous conversations on diverse topics.
✅ Improve fluency, pronunciation, and listening comprehension.
✅ Get real-time corrections and feedback to refine your speech.
✅ Feel comfortable speaking Spanish in any situation.

This course is for learners who want to practice, not just study. Whether you're preparing for travel, work, or just want to speak more like a native, this is the perfect way to put your Spanish into action!

📌 Perfect for: Those who want to practice speaking and become more fluent through conversation.
